Source caches and build archives were kept outside the repository during private experiments. The network source arrangement in SOURCE_OFFER.md combines the repository source, original upstream source access, modifications, scripts and notices tied to artifact hashes; it does not consist of a bare fetch URL.

Third-party original license texts and copyright statements are preserved. Historical notes saying the application's own code was UNLICENSED describe the experiment at that time; [LICENSING.md](LICENSING.md) records the current original-code grant.
